patches.author: Sunny River
patches.original_message:
modelnet: make supervisor PID header portable

The native Windows daemon init.cpp target includes supervisor.h without
Modelnet's private compatibility header. Its unguarded pid_t member is
therefore undeclared. Use a signed placeholder on the existing unsupported
Windows spawn path; retain pid_t on POSIX and include its defining header.
No spawn, process ownership, lifecycle or MatMul acceptance code changes.

Refs #356. Thanks to repch1c for the Windows defect inventory and
Jpp-matata for independent native Windows investigation.

patches.author: Sunny River
patches.original_message:
modelnet: provide native regular-file predicate

The native Windows CRT does not declare S_ISREG, so the real Modelnet
store.cpp target cannot compile its post-materialization file-type check.
Provide the missing predicate in the existing Windows compatibility
header, with exact file-type mask equality. Preserve existing definitions,
POSIX behavior, lstat/reparse handling and all storage safety checks.

Refs #356. Thanks to repch1c for the Windows inventory and Jpp-matata
for independent native Windows investigation.

patches.author: Sunny River
patches.original_message:
test: make backend capability fixtures portable on Windows

Use the native CRT environment API following the existing Metal guard.
Retain POSIX headers and the Metal zero-copy allocation body on POSIX;
on Windows keep the case registered and check backend unavailability.
Add scoped environment restoration tests.
